module: Detects in free roaming the switch to drift "cruising" mode: when the player chains enough drifts (or does a very long drift), the drift context goes from "inFreeroam" to "inFreeroamCruising" (which shows the drift interface) then goes back to "inFreeroam" after a few seconds without drifting. Reads gameplay_drift_drift and drives gameplay_drift_general.setContext.
notes: Hardcoded thresholds: drift >= 1.5 s with at least 3 chained drifts, or drift >= 3.2 s; the drift must not have ended within 25 m of its starting point (otherwise it is a donut, not cruising); the interface is disabled after 3 s without drifting.
The end countdown uses dtSim (simulated time), so it is slowed/frozen with slow motion or pause.
The onDriftFreeroamCruisingStarted hook is emitted with no argument when switching to cruising.
The local function getGC (profiler garbage) is not exported: dead code.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: tests the start of cruising (detectStart) then its end (detectEnd). If general debug is active, measures the cost with a LuaProfiler.

dtSim.desc: Simulated time delta in seconds, used for the end countdown.
